query: MATCH (ai:AgendaItem) WHERE ai.agendaNumber='6.6.3' OR ai.agendaNumber STARTS WITH '6.6.3.' MATCH (m:Meeting) WHERE m.canonicalMeetingNumber='RAN4#'+ai.meetingNumber OPTIONAL MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(ai), (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m) WITH m,count(DISTINCT r) AS resolutionCount RETURN m.canonicalMeetingNumber AS meeting,m.meetingNumberInt AS meetingNumber,resolutionCount ORDER BY meetingNumber ASC,meeting ASC
